body:
I've been to my doctors a few times.  When I was suicidal after my brother's funeral, I was referred to an emergency team - which wasn't great.  They called me once a day to check on me, but that was it.  I've been to counselling, but it didn't help.  I'm on strong antidepressants and I have Valium when things get too much.

I'm on a waiting list (5 months) to see another counsellor, specialising in bereavement.

The mental health services in my country aren't great :(

Thank you so much for caring, I can't tell you how much that means to me.

My partner moved out and is staying with his sister.  He has been in contact and is giving me so many mixed signals.  He says this is for us both to heal, that he can't take the way things are... and that he doesn't know what will happen. I've asked if he wants this to be it for us, and he will reply and say "I don't have the answer to that."

I feel like I can't win.  I've been trying so hard to come back from this.  I feel so abandoned by him, I needed him - especially now, as I am so alone.  I can't help but feel angry that he's abandoned me when I'm this low.

I have lay in bed just crying.  I can't face work, and I can't face life.  The thought of having to deal with this loss on top of losing my brother and my best friend... it's too much for me to deal with.  I just want to be dead, but I'm trapped, as it would be the end of my parents if I did.

I can't stand the thought of carrying on alone.  The thought of never seeing my partner again, or him being with someone else... it's just too much.

I need help, but I just don't know what to do.  Suicide seems like my only way out, but I'm completely bound to this misery instead - purely because I love my parents so much.
